newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds underpinned by 100.60s support zone.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds underpinned by 100.60s support zone.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE can still push ahead as long as they hold on above the 100.60 area, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"Bunds have come down to their old top area around 100.68/58," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London. "Anything in the 100.60s should be pretty well supported."
By 0655 GMT, Bunds were quoted at 100.73, up three basis points in early trade.
"If you start getting back into the 100.50s I would look for 100.44/39 and 100.21/28," he said.
Wood said support at 100.21/28 came from swing levels during the contract's latest spurt higher.

Technical analysts at Chase in London would use the current weakness to buy. "Given the impulsive structure of the advance from 99.32 plus trendline support intervening at 100.45 and 100.30 we regard setbacks into this area as a buying opportunity," they said in a research note.

Wood said the contract must get above the 100.88 area to really get going again. "On the way down it stumbled there," he said. "That will target the current high and very big resistance at 101.55," he said.
September Bunds hit a high of 101.10 on Monday. The peak of the recent range was the 101.55 high hit on May 14.
At the short end, December Euromarks, which were now trading heavier volume and open interest than the September contract, were quoted at 96.72, up two basis points from Monday's settlement.
